title: Pure Batteryman
summary: Batteryman cards with Thunder Dragon Colossus, generic staples, and an automatic Extra Deck. Batterymen are LIGHT Thunder monsters that swarm copies of themselves to trigger board-wiping Spells and fuel high-ATK OTKs.

summary.title: Starters
points: Batteryman Solar sends any Thunder monster from the Deck to the GY on Normal or Special Summon, spawns a Batteryman Token whenever a Thunder monster is Normal or Special Summoned, and copies the name of a Batteryman in the field or GY.
Batteryman 9-Volt searches any Batteryman monster when Summoned and doubles its own ATK/DEF to 2000 for the turn before destroying itself in the End Phase.
Batteryman Charger Special Summons any Batteryman except itself from the hand or Deck when Normal Summoned, gaining 300 ATK/DEF for each Thunder you control.
Batteryman Micro-Cell Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Batteryman from the Deck when flipped face-up and draws a card if destroyed by battle.

summary.title: Opening: Batteryman Solar + Battery Charger
steps: Normal Summon Batteryman Solar and send Batteryman 9-Volt or Batteryman AA from the Deck to the GY.
Activate Battery Charger for 500 LP to revive Batteryman 9-Volt; 9-Volt searches Batteryman Charger or Batteryman Fuel Cell while Solar summons a Batteryman Token.

Use the three Batteryman names on the field to activate Short Circuit and wipe the opponent's board, or Tribute a Thunder Effect Monster whose effect activated in the hand to summon Thunder Dragon Colossus.

summary.title: Swarm & Name Copying
summary.text: Batteryman AA gains 1000 ATK for each Attack Position Batteryman AA you control, reaching 3000 ATK each when three copies are on the field. Batteryman Solar can target a Batteryman AA in the GY to copy its name for the turn, immediately counting as an additional copy for AA's stat boost while also supplying the third Batteryman required for Short Circuit or Batteryman Fuel Cell.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Batteryman Industrial Strength banishes 2 Batteryman monsters from the GY to Special Summon itself from the hand, then banishes a Thunder from the GY once per turn to destroy 1 monster and 1 Spell/Trap on the field.
Batteryman Fuel Cell Special Summons itself from the hand while you control 2 or more Batteryman monsters and Tributes another Batteryman to return an opposing card to the hand.

Super-Electromagnetic Voltech Dragon gains bonus effects based on which Batteryman (D, C, or AA) was Tributed for its Tribute Summon, and Thunder Dragon Colossus locks the opponent out of searching cards from their Deck.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Short Circuit destroys all cards the opponent controls while you control 3 or more Batteryman monsters.
Battery Charger pays 500 LP to revive a Batteryman from the GY, while Portable Battery Pack revives 2 Batterymen in Attack Position from the GY.
Quick Charger recovers 2 Level 4 or lower Batteryman monsters from the GY to the hand as a Quick-Play Spell.

main: Newest: mills a Thunder; makes a token on every Thunder summon; copies a Batteryman name.
Searches a Batteryman when summoned; destroys itself in the End Phase.
Calls a Batteryman from the hand or Deck when Normal Summoned.
Gains 1000 ATK or DEF per AA in matching positions.
Calls another AAA from the hand or GY when Normal Summoned.
Flips into a Level 4 or lower Batteryman from the Deck.
Banishes two Batterymen to summon itself; destroys a monster and a Spell/Trap.
Joins next to two Batterymen; tributes one to bounce a card.
Keeps attacks off your other Thunders.
Tribute a Batteryman for a matching bonus.
Pays 500 LP to revive a Batteryman.
With three Batterymen, destroys every card they control.
extra: Contact Fusion: prevents opponent from adding cards from Deck to hand except by drawing, and protects itself by banishing Thunders.

allow.Thunder Dragon Colossus: Endboard floodgate boss summoned by tributing an in-archetype Thunder monster.
